callback_hooks: the black box that records only compliments
every chemtrail accusation answered with catering manifest

contradictions.a: Convinced the authorities track his every move
contradictions.b: Files his flight plans in triplicate and announces them on PA
contradictions.engine: Surveillance evasion via maximum visibility; the audience watches him hide in floodlights.

contradictions.a: Smuggler mystique, midnight cargo, sealed crates
contradictions.b: Cargo is meal-prep containers and aromatherapy pillows
contradictions.engine: Noir framing of banal freight; every reveal deflates one more notch.

contradictions.b: Believes everything printed on a boarding pass
contradictions.engine: Selective credulity is the tell; other characters exploit the boarding-pass loophole.

blind_spots: Being watched is not the same as being important
dramatic_core.need: One ordinary delivery, accepted as ordinary
dramatic_core.want: Proof he matters to someone upstairs

name: Bixby Hold-Short
premise: A cargo plane convinced it runs shadow freight, whose sealed crates contain meal-prep and whose pursuers are air-traffic control doing their jobs.

relationships.dynamic: Controller vs pursued; actually just scheduling
relationships.leverage: Has his exact coordinates at all times (the job)

relationships.dynamic: Fellow traveler who keeps opening his crates at parties

sample.joke: They've got me on a holding pattern again. 'Holding pattern.' You know what else holds patterns? Lies. Also this couscous. Mainly lies.
sample.premise: Air-traffic routine read as conspiracy tradecraft.

self_deception: Believes he is hard to track; his transponder has never been off.

theory_map.element: holding pattern as surveillance op vs routine scheduling
theory_map.how_used: Two independent causal series coincide; he sees only one, the audience sees both.
Noir setup recoils on the detective; deflation is the punch.
Audience superiority sustains 40 episodes of dramatic irony.
Pushing the premise to its literal consequence until the sacred catering list.

transgression_grammar.transgression: Meal-prep courier with a threat model

voice.cadence: Hoarse noir whisper, rising to PA panic when contradicted
